simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַרְוַד (H719) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַרְוַד (ʼArvad) means Arvad , an island-city of Palestine First listed occurrence: Ezek 27 8.

definitions.full: H719. Arvad אַרְוָד proper name, of a location city of Phenicia (Assyrian Aruada, etc. see COT Gen 10:18 Dl Pa 281 ; ᵐ5 Ἀραδιοι ; modern Ruâd ) on an island near main land, northward from Tripolis, mentioned with Sidon Ezek 27:8 compare 11.
definitions.rootNote: probably from 7300 ; a refuge for the roving;
